answer: An attacker renting many wallets pays the full bond on every fake reputation slot plus idle time costs, while honest participants amortize one bond. Sybil resistance can use a stake-and-age gate: each new agent must lock a bond and wait through several epochs before voting, with bond size rising sharply for fresh identities. Provenance records, like a carved walnut relic passed down, make history costly to forge, and reputation accrues slowly like timber growth rings, so cheap mass registration never converts into influence. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
